notes.title: Localiztion and Full Release!
notes.notes:
Hello. Perhaps you have not heard yet that we added a large patch with the localization, we hope that it is of high quality and you liked it!

Localization was done by a professional studio, with which we worked for a very long time and tried to do everything as good as possible, but there may still be some imperfections. If you find any - report to our forum!

The game is translated into: Chinese (simplified), French, German, Spanish, Italian.

The game releases! We consider it full and high-quality. In this patch, everything that was sent to us was fixed and there should not be problems with the game.

We always try to speak honestly and openly. We hope that the release will slightly increase your interest in the game, as recently it fell. Partially that's because we have been doing the project for too long, now our team is growing. Further support of the game as well as the DLC output will depend on the interest in the game.

Thank you for your tremendous support during early access, YOU ARE THE BEST! It was very nice to walk through all this way shoulder to shoulder with you.
We will try to do even more cool projects and we hope that interest in the game will grow. In any case, we still do not say goodbye to you!

The game will be complemented by content and finalized. We will do our best! :heart:

notes.title: Long-awaited update!
notes.notes:
It's difficult to call this patch the other way because we promised it a long time ago and every time we put it off for some reason. Many people thought that we abandoned the project, but in fact, we were in an extremely difficult situation.Before we discuss the details of the patch , let us tell what happened.
The main reason for so much time to finish the game is an ordinary lack of experience, as we have said many times, this is our first project and we have only two people in a team. We simply did not calculate our time and effort, worked hard, and as a result, this led to a lot of problems. Initially, when creating the game, we didn’t think over some things and, for example, when we decided to make the players not start the campaign again after each update, it turned out that we had to rework half of the game code, by the way, we were able to implement this function, but more on that later!
We tried to work more, often sat at night, worked hard, eventually it only played a big minus, had to take a break from work, lost a lot of time, and there was no one to replace us. Now we understand that it is better to work stably, little by little, but steadily. In parallel with all this, we communicated with a large number of people, about the expansion of the team, of course, very few people are ready to engage in such work without payment, and we cannot financially afford to pay for the work of even one person. On Steam, we left without publishers, like a truly indie team and a special thanks to you, for your support, for telling friends about the game, buying it, if not you, we would not manage to succed. 
Now the team is expanded and there will be more of us! We are still negotiating and we cannot announce the exact number of people in the team, but we can say one thing for sure - we are not going to leave the gaming industry, this is what we really like, what inspires us! 

All of the above is reflected in the development and I think you have shared it with us.The patch was not as big as we would like, but it will finally complete the storyline of the game and bring some interesting innovations! What next? Our roadmap is not only expending this project fixing and ironing out many things, but also new projects, about which we really do not know anything yet, everything is at the stage of the idea! 

Thanks again to all for your support, you are the best! 

Patch description:

    Now it's possible continue the company after big updates. (Previously had to start a new game) 
    Introduced a new location "Island of the Damned". 
    Finished the storyline of the game. 
    Added new weapons. 
    Added new types of accessories giving interesting abilities. (vampirism, call of minions, etc.) 
    Added night merchant who sells useful scrolls. 
    Added mounts. (Not many). 
    Added new treasures in the Ice Cave and Sunglade. 
    Slime farm can now be created. 
    Added new species of nightmares that begin to attack from the 30th day. 
    Now the lamp needs less fuel. 
    Fixed sticky keys after the resurrection with an ice cream and after dying on a ship. 
    Fixed bug when the owl could not attack bosses. 
    Added some decorations for houses. 
    Improved network connection to the game. 
    Added some achivemesnts. 
    Many of other small fixes.


We also ordered high-quality localization in French, German, Italian, Spanish and Chinese languages!
We cannot afford more languages financially. Hope you are happy if your native language is supported. 

Localization will be introduced in 3-4 months, since we have to prepare fonts and test everything from scratches.

Best regards,
team Owlet

notes.title: Discounts and upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello! there has not been any news for a long time, further we'll tell you why and for now we have a couple of good news.

First of all - an update that finishes the storyline of the game will be released before the end of this month, we hope you will like it!

Secondly - we made you a 50% discount on the game! Hope this compensates the long time you've been waiting and helps you to purchase the game for friends of yours.

We also ordered high-quality localization in French, German, Italian, Spanish and Chinese languages!
We cannot afford more languages financially. Hope you are happy if your native language is supported. 

Localization will be introduced in 3-4 months, since we have to prepare fonts and test everything from scratches.

Best regards,
team Owlet

notes.title: Update 4.09.2018
notes.notes:
Good day our snow addicts! Due to the high amount of bugs and feedback we made up our mind to release a new small update. (The global big update is planned to be released in the end of the year.) Thanks to everyone and have fun playing!

    Introduced Xbox gamepad support! (in a testing phase) 
    Redesigned the interface. 
    Added stamina regeneration ring. 
    Now it's possible to change the direction when attack. (for melee weapons) 
    Reduced the cooldown of "Wind Blade" from 15 to 9 sec. 
    Reduced the HP of "Knigness". 
    Now it's possible to bind f1-f12 and numpad keys. 
    Fixed the bug when money zeroed out after reaching 65536. 
    Fixed a bug where the description of the item was not displayed when the mouse was hovering over additional inventory of the pet. 
    Fixed a bug where the character could die from heat or hunger during a dialogue. 
    Fixed hitbox of chests turned to the right. 
    Fixed a bug with pet feeding. 
    Improved rain and snowstorm: 
- reduced the duration of events 
- the sound gets lower when entering room
- reduced frequency of snowdrifts and oil puddles 
- dimmed the light during daytime 
- drifts now do not appear on ice 
    Fixed typos in English translation.

notes.title: Small update 23.06.2018
notes.notes:
Good day, dear players, before the global update, which is now in development, we decided to release a small patch that will bring some innovations to the game, fix a large number of bugs and perhaps you'll just be glad that we are still working on the game. As usual, we are late for schedules, for which we apologize. Thanks to everyone and have fun!

    Improved the menu of character select.
    Introduced some character features. 
    Added the possibility of reviving allies. (press E nearby the heart) 
    Fixed a bug when the splash screen displayed incorrectly in multiplayer. 
    Fixed an incorrect display of Alice when shooting with a bow. 
    Fixed a bug with wrong mark on the map in the pirate quest. 
    Fixed a bug when it was possible to blow the pirate ship with bombs. 
    Improved the appearance of monsters on the pirate ship. 
    Garden bed can now be built not only in the snow biomes. 
    New Year's content is now disabled. 
    Now the map show the abilities of the obelisks. 
    Monsters no longer spawn in SunGlade village. 
    Reduced agro range of summer location monsters. 
    Added waffle maker (recipes drop from robots, they can already be opened for characters created before the update due to shift of the list of recipes) 
    The farmer now sells additional items used for craft. 
    Added a new plant in snow location (requires starting a new game) 
    Added new weather conditions, which occur at a random time (on average every 5 days) on snow, robo and summer locations. 
    Fixed a bug when an owl doesn’t attack Ancient Machine. 
    The new skills’ text has been reworked. 
    The text of summer content in English and Russian versions of the game has been completely reworked. 
    Added new sounds to improve the atmosphere of the game. 
    Fixed a big number of small bugs.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
The long-awaited patch finally came out! On the way there were a lot of unforeseen problems, but it's good that we coped with them,special thanks for your support, we very much appreciate that you are waiting for the update with such impatience. 

Let's start with the most unpleasant moment in the patch - in order to see the new content it will be necessary to start a new game, everything that you had in your previous games will be lost, this is due to the location generation system, it is generated at the very beginning and it'll be difficult to make any changes without 
further bugs. The next patches will be not like this one, we'll try to save all the progress you have. We also added 2 new heroes Alice and Tony to make your new game more intresting, both heroes have unique branches of talents! 
Briefly about the changes: 
- 2 new heroes, Alice and Tony who are available from the start of the game, both characters have unique branches of talents 
- The roofs of houses are completely redrawn 
- Added additional rotations of the roof, for greater freedom of action during construction 
- Added additional types of roofs for more variety 
- Completely reworked economy, now the rare fish won't cost 10 coins. 
- Fixed a mini-game "in a cage" it will no longer be your new home. 
- Added 1 additional ability to each class. 
- Added the ability to tame pets, you can find an NPC in a rebuilt village who will help you with taming. 
- Continuation of the storyline, we'll find out what happened to our heroes in new adventures. 
- Improved network connection, we still recommend to play through Evolve or Hamachi including Lan IP mode in the game. But the network is reworked, we hope this will solve the problems of players who did not have multiplayer run properly. 
- Added several side quests. 
- Added long-awaited steamcards, icons, backgrounds and smiles on Steam !!! 
- Fixed numerous minor bugs sent to us during the development of a new patch 
- New weapons and armor 
- New items for the interior of the house: lamps, carpets, iron beds 
- Reworked old locations 

It took a lot of time to try to make mac and linux platforms. We ran into some trouble - the game engine do not allow us to do it. We adressed the engine developers, they informed us that they knew about this problem. Once it is fixed, we will release the game to other platforms. 

Thanks to everyone for waiting, we will try not to disappoint you and make the project faster and better. Enjoy the game and wishing you a happy holiday season!

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Small New Year Feel The Snow Update.
notes.notes:
Added an ability to play over the network with other players (not only with your friends): 
You can create a public server that will be available for any Steam user in public server list. (Join game->Via Steam->Public servers).
  Added New Year content. 
  Added a new mob (Requires the creation of a new world) 
  Added an ability to see a list of players on the server with TAB key (can be changed in controls menu). 
  Added an ability to ban players from the server and clear the list of banned players in the list of players. 
  Added an ability to highlight players names with Alt (can be changed in controls menu). 
  Added an ability to insert IP from the clipboard when connecting via LAN IP. (Ctrl+V). 
  Now dash interrupts attack animation. 


 Bugs:  
  Bug fixed with frozen dialog when player disconnects from the server. 
  Bug fixed with skipping letters in game chat. 
  Bug fixed with some tiles when building a garden bed nearby snowless lands. 

Best Regards, 
Owlet Team.
